subject: planner: keep join keys for join optimization in constant propagation (#63404)
summary: Adds an opt-in mechanism to preserve column-column join keys during constant propagation (inner/outer join paths) so join reorder / join algorithm selection can still see equality edges after propagation rewrites; introduces sysvar `tidb_opt_always_keep_join_key` (default OFF) and threads it through planner call sites, with new plan tests covering reported regressions.
